caption: OPT-13B results with zero-shot, in-context learning (ICL), MeZO, and fine-tuning with Adam (FT). MeZO demonstrates superior results over zero-shot and ICL and performs on par with FT (within 1%) on 7 out of 11 tasks, despite using only 1/12 of the memory.

Experiments on RoBERTa-large. We report zero-shot, linear probing (LP), MeZO, and fine-tuning (FT) with full parameter, LoRA, and prefix-tuning. MeZO outperforms zero-shot and LP and approaches FT (within 5% for k=512) with much less memory.

GPU memory consumption with different OPT models and tuning methods on MultiRC (400 tokens per example on average). MeZO uses the same memory as inference while offering up to 12x savings over standard FT.
